items.headline: Nix's punt return TD, clutch interception by Lyles lift Jacksonville State over Georgia Southern
items.description: — Caleb Nix returned a punt 75 yards for the go-ahead score, Tristan Lyles had a game-saving interception in the red zone, and Jacksonville State erased a 14-point halftime deficit...

items.headline: Backup QB Tait Reynolds leads 5 scoring drives as Clemson defeats Georgia Southern 22-7
items.description: — Freshman Tait Reynolds replaced an injured Christopher Vizzina at quarterback and threw for 178 yards and led five scoring drives as Clemson defeated Georgia Southern 22-7 on Saturday night following a two-hour lightning delay.
